family.description: This family contains several NIF (B, Y and X) proteins which are iron-molybdenum cofactors (FeMo-co) in the dinitrogenase enzyme which catalyses the reduction of dinitrogen to ammonium. Dinitrogenase is a hetero-tetrameric (alpha(2)beta(2)) enzyme which contains the iron-molybdenum cofactor (FeMo-co) at its active site [[cite:PUB00019929]].
family.name: Dinitrogenase iron-molybdenum cofactor
